summary_en: 800,700 shares (2.47% of S/O) to be acquired at ¥4,460/share via ToSTNeT-3 on 28 August 2026; total outlay ¥3,571.1M; settlement same-day. Stated reason: capital efficiency and agile capital policy in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares through off-exchange purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Furukawa Co. announced on 27 August 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange purchase transaction) on 28 August 2026. The company will place an order to purchase up to 800,700 shares (2.47% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at the closing price of ¥4,460 per share, with a maximum aggregate outlay of ¥3,571.1M. The purchase will occur during the morning session of the ToSTNeT-3 trading window (08:45 JST) on 28 August, and results will be announced immediately after the transaction closes. The company stated the rationale as improving capital efficiency and enabling agile capital policy in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 July 2026, Furukawa held 107,899 treasury shares against 32,437,669 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
